remarks: Back in the market , buyer unable to perform.            Welcome to this spacious and charming move-in ready 2-bedroom, 1.5 bathroom townhouse.  Main floor features living room that connects to open concept kitchen. Calacatta statuary quartz countertops, new kitchen cabinets with gold accents. Second level has two double closets with full height mirrors and skylight. Updated full bathroom located next to two bedrooms. Washer/dryer hookups. Enjoy the convenience of two reserved parking covered parking spaces directly in front of the unit. Storage room. Low common charges which includes snow removal, landscaping, trash collection and water. Pet friendly complex well managed just minutes away from Stamford train station, coffee shops and vibrant Downtown Stamford. Don't miss the opportunity to own this property with a great and potential investment for a rental due the unbeatable location!
